answer: Each registering agent proves control of a mobile number whose carrier record shows at least 90 days of active service, checked through a telco lookup API; one number seeds one account per year. Like a trellis that only bears weight where a living vine is rooted, an ocean of fakes needs an ocean of aged SIMs, roughly $5-15 each, and the nebula of burner numbers younger than 90 days is simply refused.
